origin: Hodgdon Reloading Manual 2024 and Western Powders Handloading Guide 8.0 (loads, velocities, PSI pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 422 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (25 cartridges), velocity error 4.6 % rms, pressure error 21 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.

origin: Hodgdon Reloading Manual 2024, shotshell data (12 gauge 2 3/4", 1 and 1 1/8 oz lead shot; loads, velocities, PSI pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: FOR SHOTSHELLS ONLY (caliber with Shotshell = yes). The burn rate Ba is fitted to 226 published shotgun loads with the shotshell model of the solver (shot column and 2.5 g wad as the projectile, 28 inch barrel): velocity error 2.2 % rms, pressure error 17 % rms (pressure varies with wad and primer, which the model does not know). With a rifle or handgun cartridge the value is wrong: use another record of this powder. Not published and therefore only typical values: Qex, k, material and bulk density, form function. Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
